name: DUMBBELL LYING TRICEPS EXTENSION
introduce: Lie on a bench. Hold a dumbbell in each hand. Extend your arms towards the ceiling and tilt them slightly back. \n\nKeep your elbows still. Slowly lower the dumbbells until your elbows are about 90 degrees. Return and repeat.

tips.text: Please make sure your arms are tilted back slightly.
Exhale as you lift the dumbbells, and inhale as you lower them.
